capacity.title: Capacity and effectiveness
capacity.label: Capacity
capacity.note: Under capacity: below 70% in use. Right amount: 70–89%. Over capacity: 90% or more. Thursday's heatwave is expected to push beds over capacity.

effectiveness.label: Overall effectiveness
effectiveness.context: out of 100 · Abu Dhabi average {{average}} · highest of the {{n}} largest facilities
effectiveness.note: Effectiveness is the average of these three measures. The Department of Health uses the same score for every facility.
